It is supported by descriptive evidence (Figure 1, the constancy of Danish top income shares) and by the robustness of the estimates to pre-reform income controls (Table 3), not by any single printed coefficient, so results is empty by design. The abstract's first sentence ('This paper estimates taxable income responses using a series of Danish tax reforms and population-wide administrative data since 1980.') was read as a topic/data sentence rather than a separate finding; its content is carried by the scope fields of the claims below.
